Name: Intensity
Description: Controls the strength of the slope warp effect. Higher values produce more pronounced warping and distortion of the terrain along the slope.

Name: Iterations
Description: Specifies how many times the slope warp operation is applied. Increasing iterations can create more complex or exaggerated warping effects.

Name: Direction
Description: Sets the primary direction in which the slope warp is applied. Adjust this to control the orientation of the warping across the terrain.

Name: Normalized
Description: When enabled, normalizes the effect so that the intensity is consistent regardless of terrain scale or resolution.

Name: Quality
Description: Settings related to the quality and precision of the slope warp operation. Higher quality may increase processing time but results in smoother, more accurate warping.

Name: Quality
Description: Settings related to the quality and precision of the slope warp operation. Higher quality may increase processing time but results in smoother, more accurate warping.

Name: Antialiasing
Description: Applies antialiasing to the slope warp effect, reducing jagged edges and improving visual smoothness.

Flubs.Name: Off
Flubs.Description: No antialiasing is applied. May result in sharper but potentially jagged edges.

Flubs.Name: x4
Flubs.Description: Applies 4x antialiasing for moderate smoothing of edges.

Flubs.Name: x16
Flubs.Description: Applies 16x antialiasing for maximum edge smoothing and highest visual quality.
